resources.string: Show a gold reference figure for where a rep starts and finishes, and a reference limb for a visible correction. A guide to the app\'s current targets, not a judgement of your form.
Explain one repeated cue between camera angles. Sends a measured form summary for AI advice; uses local tips when unavailable.
Spoken coaching follows your voice and volume settings. Online coach voice uses available free access, with phone speech as a fallback.
I\'m here to coach you. Keep your whole body in view, and listen for one clear tip at a time.
Let\'s use the next view to check more of your form. Focus on a controlled movement.
